records.source: Greetings! I'm Demetrius, local scientist and father. Thanks for introducing yourself!#$e#I'm studying the local plants and animals from my home laboratory.#$b#Have you met my daughter Maru? She's interested to meet you.
records.translation: Pagbati! Ako si Demetrius, siyentipiko rito at isang ama. Salamat sa pagpapakilala!#$e#Pinag-aaralan ko ang mga halaman at hayop dito mula sa laboratoryo sa bahay.#$b#Nakilala mo na ba ang anak kong si Maru? Interesado siyang makilala ka.

records.source: Wow, this is a rare substance. I'll have to take it to the lab for... uh... further analysis.
records.translation: Wow, bihirang sangkap ito. Kailangan kong dalhin ito sa laboratoryo para sa... ah... karagdagang pagsusuri.

records.source: A present!... with optimal timing. Today is the anniversary of my birth. Thank you!$h
records.translation: Isang regalo!... sa pinakamainam na oras. Anibersaryo ngayon ng kapanganakan ko. Salamat!$h

records.source: A present!... with optimal timing. Today is the anniversary of my birth.$h#$b#Let's see what it is... $h#$b#...Oh.$s
records.translation: Isang regalo!... sa pinakamainam na oras. Anibersaryo ngayon ng kapanganakan ko.$h#$b#Tingnan natin kung ano ito... $h#$b#...Ah.$s

records.source: Wow, an intact dinosaur egg! This is an extremely rare specimen. Now, if only it could be incubated...
records.translation: Wow, isang buo at hindi napinsalang itlog ng dinosauro! Napakabihirang espesimen nito. Kung mapapapisa lamang ito...

records.source: I already spotted a rare crab. This place is great.$h
records.translation: Nakakita na ako ng bihirang alimango. Napakaganda ng lugar na ito.$h

records.source: Don't mind me, @. I'm just collecting some samples. This may be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!$7#$e#Erm... If you see my wife, can you tell her I'm okay?$7
records.translation: Huwag mo akong alalahanin, @. Nangongolekta lang ako ng ilang sampol. Maaaring minsan lamang sa buong buhay dumating ang pagkakataong ito!$7#$e#Ah... Kung makita mo ang asawa ko, maaari mo bang sabihing ayos lang ako?$7

records.source: The rain appears to be harmless, so I'm taking less precaution this year.
records.translation: Mukhang hindi mapanganib ang ulan, kaya hindi na ako gaanong nag-iingat ngayong taon.

records.source: I heard you visited Calico Desert recently. How fascinating! I'm sure you observed many unique life forms on your trip.
records.translation: Narinig kong pumunta ka kamakailan sa Disyerto ng Calico. Lubhang kawili-wili! Tiyak na marami kang napansing natatanging anyo ng buhay sa paglalakbay.

records.source: Checking up on the melon research? Yes, I... uh... 'analyzed' it, and it certainly has an optimal macronutrient profile...
records.translation: Kinukumusta mo ba ang pananaliksik sa melon? Oo, ako ay... ah... “sinuri” iyon, at tiyak na pinakamainam ang komposisyon ng mga makronutriyente nito...

records.source: Say that again!? You successfully incubated a dinosaur egg? This is unprecedented!$5#$e#Here, take my coffee, I'm all worked up now... I can't drink any more. [253]
records.translation: Sabihin mo ulit!? Matagumpay kang nakapagpisa ng itlog ng dinosauro? Wala pang ganitong nangyari!$5#$e#Heto, kunin mo ang kape ko. Sabik na sabik ako ngayon... Hindi na ako maaaring uminom pa. [253]

records.source: Yes, Maru told me the news. I can't say I'm thrilled about it, but maybe you'll prove me wrong.$u
records.translation: Oo, sinabi sa akin ni Maru ang balita. Hindi ko masasabing natutuwa ako, pero baka patunayan mong mali ako.$u

records.source: *sigh*... @, I've come to accept that it's time for my 'little girl' to become a woman. You have my blessing.$s
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*... @, tinanggap ko nang panahon na upang maging ganap na babae ang “munting anak ko”. Basbas ko ang pagsasama ninyo.$s

records.source: Congratulations on the marriage. Robin's been crying since the wedding. 'Tears of joy', as she calls it! A most peculiar concept...#$e#Hmm, now that the basement is unoccupied, I might have to expand the laboratory...$u
records.translation: Binabati ko kayo sa kasal. Umiiyak si Robin mula noong kasal. “Luha ng kagalakan” daw! Lubhang kakaibang konsepto...#$e#Hmm, ngayong walang nakatira sa silong, baka palawakin ko ang laboratoryo...$u

records.source: $y 'How's that cave experiment coming along? Has it produced anything of value yet?_Yes_Ah! That means the conditions must be more suitable than I originally theorized... hmm..._No_Well, keep checking on it every now and then. I'm sure those little guys will yield something eventually.'
records.translation: $y 'Kumusta ang eksperimento sa yungib? May naibigay na ba itong mahalaga?_Oo_Ah! Ibig sabihin, mas angkop ang mga kalagayan kaysa sa una kong teorya... hmm..._Hindi_Aba, tingnan mo lang iyon paminsan-minsan. Tiyak na may maibibigay din ang maliliit na nilalang na iyon kalaunan.'

records.source: Don't forget to check that farm cave! There's bound to be something useful in there by now.
records.translation: Huwag kalimutang tingnan ang yungib sa bukid! Tiyak na may kapaki-pakinabang na roon ngayon.

records.source: I'll be analyzing this data for months.
records.translation: Ilang buwan kong susuriin ang datos na ito.

records.source: *crunch*... whoops, there goes an endangered crab species...$s#$b#...#$b#Oh, never mind. It was just the empty shell! I can sleep tonight.
records.translation: *langutngot*... Naku, napatay ko ang isang nanganganib na uri ng alimango...$s#$b#...#$b#Ah, hindi pala. Walang laman na talukap lang iyon! Makakatulog ako ngayong gabi.

records.source: Are you having fun, @? You need to remember to take breaks now and then too!
records.translation: Nagsasaya ka ba, @? Kailangan mo ring tandaan na magpahinga paminsan-minsan!

records.source: I usually don't partake... but I'm usually not on a tropical island, either. Hahaha.$h
records.translation: Hindi ako karaniwang umiinom... pero hindi rin naman ako karaniwang nasa tropikal na isla. Hahaha.$h

records.source: Can you believe this place? It's teeming with exotic life!
records.translation: Makapaniwala ka ba sa lugar na ito? Hitik ito sa mga kakaibang nilalang!

records.source: It's a good specimen, but a very common species. You can keep it.
records.translation: Magandang espesimen ito, pero napakakaraniwang uri. Maaari mong itabi.

records.source: Fruit and salt? What an odd combination...$s
records.translation: Prutas at asin? Kakaibang kumbinasyon...$s

records.source: Robin won't even tell *me* who paid for Pam's new house!#$e#I pretend I'm mad at her but secretly I'm glad she's so loyal to her word...$h
records.translation: Kahit sa *akin* ay ayaw sabihin ni Robin kung sino ang nagbayad sa bagong bahay ni Pam!#$e#Nagkukunwari akong galit sa kaniya, pero lihim akong natutuwang napakatapat niya sa kaniyang salita...$h

records.source: Maru helps me out in the lab sometimes... She's a good kid.
records.translation: Minsan ay tinutulungan ako ni Maru sa laboratoryo... Mabuti siyang bata.

records.source: It's hard to do good science without Maru's help...#$b#But her happiness is much more important than my experiment!
records.translation: Mahirap gumawa ng mahusay na agham nang wala ang tulong ni Maru...#$b#Pero higit na mahalaga ang kaligayahan niya kaysa eksperimento ko!

records.source: This valley has a very vibrant and diverse ecosystem. That's one reason I was excited to move here.
records.translation: Napakasigla at sari-sari ng ekosistema sa lambak na ito. Isa iyon sa mga dahilan kung bakit sabik akong lumipat dito.

records.source: You're probably growing a lot of interesting plants on your farm, huh?#$e#Maybe I'll stop by your place some day and check it out.
records.translation: Malamang ay marami kang kawili-wiling halamang itinatanim sa bukid, ano?#$e#Baka dumaan ako sa tahanan mo balang araw upang tingnan ang mga iyon.

records.source: How's the farming business going? It's parsnip season, isn't it?#$e#I can imagine it being pretty peaceful, working outdoors with plants all day.
records.translation: Kumusta ang pagsasaka? Panahon ng parsnip ngayon, hindi ba?#$e#Naiisip kong napakapayapang magtrabaho sa labas kasama ang mga halaman buong araw.

records.source: Robin has a hot temper. It's better to stay on her good side.#$e#Don't tell her I said that.$h
records.translation: Mainitin ang ulo ni Robin. Mas mabuting panatilihin ang magandang pakikitungo niya sa iyo.#$e#Huwag mong sabihin sa kaniya na sinabi ko iyon.$h

records.source: Let's see... If compounds in the rhizosphere contain sufficient levels of Carbon-13, then...$u#$b#Oh! Sorry. I was pondering some data and I didn't notice you there.#$e#Do you need anything?
records.translation: Tingnan natin... Kung may sapat na antas ng Carbon-13 ang mga tambalan sa rizospera, kung gayon...$u#$b#Ah! Paumanhin. Pinag-iisipan ko ang ilang datos at hindi ko napansing naroon ka.#$e#May kailangan ka ba?

records.source: It's good to take a break from work every now and then.#$e#I guess that's kind of difficult when you live on a farm, though.#$e#Hey, at least in the winter you don't have to worry about crops.
records.translation: Mabuting magpahinga sa trabaho paminsan-minsan.#$e#Pero marahil medyo mahirap iyon kapag nakatira ka sa bukid.#$e#Uy, sa taglamig man lang ay hindi mo kailangang mag-alala sa mga pananim.

records.source: Robin has a hot temper. It's better to stay on her good side.#$e#...now if I could only quantify her mood levels, perhaps I could model the fluctuations using a sinusoidal curve...$u
records.translation: Mainitin ang ulo ni Robin. Mas mabuting panatilihin ang magandang pakikitungo niya sa iyo.#$e#...Kung masusukat ko lamang ang antas ng kaniyang damdamin, baka mailarawan ko ang mga pagbabago gamit ang kurbang sinusoidal...$u

records.source: Hi @! How are you doing today?#$e#I wish I could make your farming job easier somehow.
records.translation: Kumusta, @! Kumusta ka ngayon?#$e#Sana may paraan akong mapadali ang trabaho mo sa pagsasaka.

records.source: Really? I figured a farmer would know the correct answer...$s
records.translation: Talaga? Akala ko, alam ng isang magsasaka ang tamang sagot...$s

records.source: See? @ agrees with me.
records.translation: Kita mo? Sang-ayon sa akin si @.

records.source: Well, we'd better titrate this solution before it crystallizes on us.
records.translation: Aba, mabuting magsagawa tayo ng titrasyon sa solusyong ito bago ito magkristal.

records.source: *sigh*... %fork$4
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*... %fork$4

records.source: #$e#%Demetrius is deep in thought.#$e#Sorry, I'm really busy.#$e#There's so many plants to study right now.
records.translation: #$e#%Malalim ang iniisip ni Demetrius.#$e#Paumanhin, talagang abala ako.#$e#Napakaraming halamang dapat pag-aralan ngayon.

records.source: Make sure to water your plants every day.#$e#Although, if you're using water retaining soil you don't need to worry about watering as often.#$e#It's pretty convenient.
records.translation: Tiyaking diligan ang mga halaman mo araw-araw.#$e#Pero kung gumagamit ka ng lupang nagpapanatili ng tubig, hindi mo kailangang mag-alalang magdilig nang madalas.#$e#Napakaginhawa niyon.

records.source: How's the farming business going? It's tomato season, isn't it?#$e#I can imagine it being pretty peaceful, working outdoors with plants all day.
records.translation: Kumusta ang pagsasaka? Panahon ng kamatis ngayon, hindi ba?#$e#Naiisip kong napakapayapang magtrabaho sa labas kasama ang mga halaman buong araw.

records.source: $p 40#So I heard Maru had you look through that telescope out back.|If you and Maru become friends, I'm sure she'll show you how to use that telescope out back.#$e#Pretty exciting, huh?
records.translation: $p 40#Narinig kong pinatingin sa iyo ni Maru ang teleskopyo sa likod.|Kung magiging magkaibigan kayo ni Maru, tiyak na ipapakita niya kung paano gamitin ang teleskopyo sa likod.#$e#Kapana-panabik, hindi ba?

records.source: I hope my daughter's keeping up on her math and science!
records.translation: Sana patuloy na sinasanay ng anak ko ang kaalaman niya sa matematika at agham!

records.source: Hmm... If strigolactone levels could be increased, would it have a proportional effect on mycorrhizal growth?$u#$b#Oh! Sorry. I was pondering some data and I didn't notice you there.#$e#Do you need anything?
records.translation: Hmm... Kung mapatataas ang antas ng strigolactone, magiging proporsiyonal kaya ang epekto nito sa paglago ng mikoriza?$u#$b#Ah! Paumanhin. Pinag-iisipan ko ang ilang datos at hindi ko napansing naroon ka.#$e#May kailangan ka ba?

records.source: I became a scientist because I wanted to contribute to the progression of our species.#$e#Of course, none of this would be possible without farmers such as yourself.$h
records.translation: Naging siyentipiko ako dahil gusto kong mag-ambag sa pagsulong ng ating uri.#$e#Siyempre, walang magiging posible rito kung wala ang mga magsasakang tulad mo.$h

records.source: During this time of year I divert my attentions to fungi.
records.translation: Sa panahong ito ng taon, ibinabaling ko ang pansin sa mga halamang-singaw.

records.source: We know a lot about nature thanks to science.#$e#But there's always a lot more to learn.
records.translation: Marami tayong alam tungkol sa kalikasan dahil sa agham.#$e#Pero palaging marami pang dapat matutuhan.

records.source: How's the farming business going? It's corn season, isn't it?#$e#I can imagine it being pretty peaceful, working outdoors with plants all day.
records.translation: Kumusta ang pagsasaka? Panahon ng mais ngayon, hindi ba?#$e#Naiisip kong napakapayapang magtrabaho sa labas kasama ang mga halaman buong araw.

records.source: Maru sure spends a lot of time working on those gadgets of hers.#$e#I'm glad she's so dedicated.
records.translation: Talagang maraming oras ang ginugugol ni Maru sa paggawa ng mga aparato niya.#$e#Natutuwa akong napakasigasig niya.

records.source: I'm still flabbergasted about Maru's secret robot... was it all a dream?
records.translation: Hindi pa rin ako makapaniwala sa lihim na robot ni Maru... Panaginip lang ba ang lahat?

records.source: Let's see... perhaps the nitrogen fixation level is affected by nematode secretions...$u#$b#Oh! Sorry. I was pondering some data and I didn't notice you there.#$e#Do you need anything?
records.translation: Tingnan natin... Baka naaapektuhan ng mga inilalabas ng nematode ang antas ng piksasyon ng nitroheno...$u#$b#Ah! Paumanhin. Pinag-iisipan ko ang ilang datos at hindi ko napansing naroon ka.#$e#May kailangan ka ba?

records.source: Hi @. I'm always glad when you come for a visit.#$e#It's nice to have some company after all this lonely lab-work.
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Palagi akong natutuwa kapag dumadalaw ka.#$e#Masarap magkaroon ng kasama matapos ang lahat ng mag-isang pagtatrabaho sa laboratoryo.

records.source: I'm taking a break from my research right now.
records.translation: Nagpapahinga ako ngayon mula sa pananaliksik.

records.source: Talk to my wife if you want to increase the size of your house.
records.translation: Kausapin mo ang asawa ko kung gusto mong palakihin ang bahay mo.

records.source: Do you have a kitchen in your house yet?#$e#Cooking is kind of like doing lab work.
records.translation: May kusina na ba sa bahay mo?#$e#Medyo katulad ng trabaho sa laboratoryo ang pagluluto.

records.source: Do you have any animals on your farm?
records.translation: May mga hayop ka ba sa bukid?

records.source: Hello.#$e#%Demetrius seems lost in thought.
records.translation: Kumusta.#$e#%Mukhang malalim ang iniisip ni Demetrius.

records.source: Let's see... if seasonal nitrogen levels could be modeled by a piecewise function...$u#$b#Oh! Sorry. I was analyzing data and I didn't notice you there.#$e#Do you need anything?
records.translation: Tingnan natin... Kung mailalarawan ang pana-panahong antas ng nitroheno gamit ang punsiyong hati-hati...$u#$b#Ah! Paumanhin. Sinusuri ko ang datos at hindi ko napansing naroon ka.#$e#May kailangan ka ba?

records.source: Feel free to harvest as much lumber and stone from this area as you please.
records.translation: Malaya kang kumuha ng kahit gaano karaming kahoy at bato mula sa lugar na ito.

records.source: Thanks for stopping by. I need to think about something other than legumes for a while.#$e#So, what have you been doing lately?#$e#That sounds interesting.
records.translation: Salamat sa pagdaan. Kailangan kong mag-isip tungkol sa ibang bagay bukod sa mga legumbre nang sandali.#$e#Kaya, ano ang ginagawa mo nitong mga nakaraan?#$e#Mukhang kawili-wili iyon.
